translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

book.name: Galatia
book.title: Suha'na Paulus lako ingganna Jumaa' dio Galatia

content: Sipamoloi mesa sola mesa

O inggannakoa' solasubungku, maka' deenna' ullambi' padammu to matappa' umpogau' dosa, indo to tubongkoa' situhu' pantettena Penaba Maseho la umpakilalaa' anna mala ma'pasule sule lako lalam kamaloloam. Sapo' la umpakilalaa' sola kamalunäsam penaba anna kasa'bahasam. Anna la unjagaikoa' kalemu indana iko sianna' duka' la maelo' ma'pogau' susi.
Anna la sipamoloikoa' mesa sola mesa umpassam kamabandasam. Aka maka' umpateemmia', iya untuhu'ingkoa' too pahentana Kristus.
Sapo' maka' deem tau ussanga-sanga kalena anna setonganna tä' sihatam, tau ia too umpasalanduam kalena.
Si mesa-mesa tau pahallu la umpesi'dinni pa'palakoanna. Aka maka' mapia, iya mala napotilalla'. Sapo' tä'um manggi' napasipetua' pa'palakoanna tau senga'.
Aka si mesa-mesa tau la ma'kale ia duka' umpalako oloanna.
Menna-menna deemmi untahima pepa'guhuam diona Battakada Debata, la pahallu duka' tau ia too muitaam katuboanna indo to umpatudui battu diua la nabeem ia piha indo to naampuam.
Daa umbulinna'. Aka Puang Allataala tä' mala dipopaningoam. Aka iai too tatanam, ia siam tia duka' tapuppu' buana.

Susinna ke ma'pogau'ki' untuhu'i sipa' dosata, iya buana ia too la ullambi'ki' kamateam, anna maka' ma'pogau'ki' situhu' pa'elo'na Penaba Maseho, iya buana ia too la ullambi'ki' katuboam sule lako salako-lakona, kahana nabeengkia' Penaba Maseho.
Dadi daa ummali-malisanna' umpogau' kamapiaam. Aka maka' tä'ungki' deem monda umpogau' kamapiaam, iya la nalambi'kia' duka' buana illaam wattu puha dipa'tantu.
Dadi sumala deempi wattu, iya la pahallua' tapake wattu ia too umpogau' kamapiaam lako ingganna hupatau, la'bi-la'binna lako solasubunta to matappa'.
Pepakilalaam anna kada salama'
Pengkalesoi manappaia' inde kasallena pantuli' aka ma'kalemä' pole' untuli'i.

Indo to maelo' umpatenggem kalena diona kaha-kaha di lino, tau iam too indo maelo' la umpassakoa' disunna'. Ia anna napateenni aka mahea' la nadahha to Yahudi, indo si keaha' ke diuai anggam mala tau dipomalolo ke ungkatappa'i tau Kristus to puha mate yabo kaju sitambem.

Anna indo tau susi ia too moi anna untuhu'i diona sunna', sapo' tä' siam duka' untuhu'i asam ingganna issinna Pepaondonganna Musa. Sapo' napeä lalanna la disunna'koa' anna mala deem napa'polalanni tenggem nasi'dim ke untuhu'ia' pepatuduanna.

Sapo' di kaona kao mannassa anna tä' kuaku la kutenggengam aka-aka senga' sulibanna indo puha napogau' Debatanta Yesus Kristus yabo kaju sitambem, iam too la kupa'kasallei. Indo anna dipatei Kristus yabo kaju sitambem, sihhapannä' duka' mate sola Kristus nasuhum tä'um deem kupaillaam penaba pole indo si napohäena to tamuissam Kristus; anna susi siam duka' tä'um deem napaillaam penabaä'.
Aka disunna' daka tau tä' daka tau disunna', setonganna tontä bäbäm dio olona Puang Allataala aka taia dipaitoo'na. Sapo' anggam pahallu dipaitoo'na la mendadi tau hupatau bakahu.

Anna ingganna tau to untuhu'i pepatuduam indo to dipaitoo'na la namana' Puang Allataala kamasannangam anna pa'kamase. Ingganna tau ia too sipäto' disangai to Israel si'da-sia, battu diua umma' to napilei Puang Allataala.
Mane deenni kuua: tä'um mala moi podo la mesa tau la umpomasussa poleä'. Aka budam bila' lako kaleku tandana pentuhu'naä' Puang Yesus.
O inggannakoa' solasubungku, handandanni Debatanta Yesus Kristus untamba'koa' pada-pada. La sule lako hi too.
Padam too.

footnotes.text: La sule lako hi too: naua illaam basa Yunani Amin.
